title: Configuring Pharmacy Loyalty Rewards Program (Earning & Value)

intro.title: Pharmacy Loyalty Program Setup
intro.subtitle: Define earning ratios, point rupee valuation, minimum redemption limits, and POS activation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 6, Part 3: Configuring Pharmacy Loyalty Rewards Program. A structured rewards program boosts repeat visits, builds customer loyalty, and drives higher basket values.
Go to Settings and select Loyalty Program. Here you control the earning ratio, point valuation, and redemption thresholds across your retail network.
In Points Accrual Rules, configure the earning ratio, such as awarding one point for every hundred rupees spent on non-scheduled medicines.
Set the point redemption value and minimum redemption threshold. For instance, each point is worth one rupee, with a minimum requirement of ten points before cashiers can redeem them at billing.
Toggle the program to Active and click Save Settings. All billing terminals now calculate reward points automatically on qualified sales invoices. In Part 4, we examine the Customer Loyalty Ledger!

outro.takeaway: Loyalty Program Configuration: Establish clear points-to-rupee ratios and redemption thresholds to increase customer retention and sales basket sizes.
